bio.text: Eric Conroy, a Republican, won the May 2026 primary for Ohio's 1st Congressional District, according to WCPO projections, and will face Democrat Greg Landsman in the November general election.
WCPO reports that he was raised on Cincinnati's west side and is a U.S. Air Force veteran who was a CIA case officer stationed in Afghanistan, Poland and Iraq before moving back to Cincinnati.

sources.title: Trump-backed Eric Conroy wins Republican primary for Ohio's 1st Congressional District
